1.d4 d6 2.c4 e5 3.dxe5 Nc6.strategy: Puts a second attacker on the e5 pawn, which nothing defends, and invites White to take another pawn on d6. Black gambles material for quick development and open lines; White can take it but has to play accurately to keep the extra material.
1.d4 d6 2.c4 e5 3.dxe5 Nc6.name: Rat Defence: English Rat, Lisbon Gambit

1.d4 d6 2.c4 e5 3.dxe5 Be6.strategy: Hits the undefended pawn on c4 while the d6-pawn still attacks e5, so Black makes two threats at once. But if White parries accurately, Black is simply a pawn down for some activity.
1.d4 d6 2.c4 e5 3.dxe5 Be6.name: Rat Defence: English Rat, Pounds Gambit
